summary: The organic website (herbert-aisolutions.com) rebuilt around the concept Runs itself: the site shows the running system instead of describing it. The homepage is being rebuilt section by section on the branch preview/runs-itself, each section drawn as three options on the real page and picked by Will, then its details the same way. Settled so far: the hero, How It Works, the AI employees roster (a scroll scene), Industries (one job start to finish per industry) and The Work. Still to come: Products, Who Builds It, Book the Audit, the industry pages and the merge to main. Nothing is live yet; the live site still shows the May 2026 design.
about: Design-led build. The method is the design-taste skill's design pass (docs/design/design-pass-site-2026-09.md is the ledger of every option and pick, in Will's words). The design language is docs/design/CHARTER.md. Research behind the structure: the September identity research and the October industries research in the files repo.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.note: identity research, five questions
phases.story: Research on what Herbert AI is and what its website should be: identity, the entry offer, what a high-ticket B2B site needs, the AI employee framing, search demand. Written up with sourced evidence.

phases.name: Requirements
phases.note: decisions file
phases.story: The decisions from the research, grilled with Will: the descriptor, the ladder and its published prices, pages and one action per page, no client names. Added 13 and 14 Oct: five industries named as industries, AI employees as the site's unit, the first AI employee replacing the Bottleneck Pilot, products on the Wispr Flow pattern.

phases.name: UX
phases.note: concept picked, charter rewritten, design pass running
phases.story: The concept Runs itself was picked from two drawn live after four rounds of reference clones were rejected. The charter was rewritten around it. Since then every section is drawn three ways on the real page and Will picks; his picks and tweaks are the ledger. Runs per section, so it stays current until the last section is picked.
left: Products, Who Builds It and Book the Audit still to draw
the details of AI Employees, Industries and The Work

phases.name: Technical design
phases.note: same stack, no new systems
phases.story: The rebuild is page sections on the existing Next.js, Tailwind and framer-motion stack with no new data or services, so there is no technical design beyond each component's header comment. The one piece of logic worth a note is the hub example page's production gate (components/site/shared.js, HUB_EXAMPLE_CLEARED).

phases.name: Plan
phases.note: eight sections settled
phases.story: The homepage's eight sections and their order were settled with Will on 14 Oct, with the rhythm of a moving section then a calm one and the research on order and motion behind it. Each section is a milestone below; the pages after the homepage are the later ones.

phases.name: Build
phases.note: five of eight sections built on preview/runs-itself
phases.story: Built so far, each after its pick: the hero (6 to 10 Oct), How It Works (10 to 12 Oct), the AI employees scene (13 to 14 Oct), The Work (13 Oct) and Industries (15 Oct), plus the two example pages under /work and the copy rename across the site. Everything is on the preview branch and visible at its Vercel preview URL.
